messages:
maya.prod: Heads up — final draft of release notes for 1.12.0 is ready. Need a staging pin and a deploybot run tomorrow 09:00 PT. Who can own the canary checks? Also confirm rollback criteria and version pin.

anita.release: I can own canary checks. I'll run the smoke suite + perf probes and watch logs. Add me to the deploybot notify list.

sam.eng: Added the staging pin in the release doc (link: https://go/release/1.12.0). Recommend deploy cadence: 2 canary waves 5% -> 30% then full. @deploy-bot can you schedule with that cadence?

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: `/deploy release=1.12.0 env=staging window=2026-03-22T16:00Z canary_waves=2 waves=5,30 notify=@anita.release,@kai.oncall`

kai.oncall: I'll be on-call for the window. Rollback criteria proposal: trigger immediate rollback if 5xx rate > 1% sustained over 5m OR latency p95 > 2s sustained over 10m. objections?

sam.eng: no objections. Also pin runtime image to `sha256:8f3a5d...c4b` and model-version to `openassistant-v2-rc` in the deploy config.

maya.prod: Internal RN snippet (keep microcopy tight):
```
- Performance: reduced per-token CPU by ~12% via prefix caching.
- Reliability: smarter canary routing to avoid noisy hosts.
- Observability: new per-route P95 + token-cost dashboard in Console.
```

maya.prod: I'll draft the internal announce once wave 2 completes. Target send to #general + account-execs at 10:30 PT if all clear.

anita.release: LGTM. Kicking off smoke now, will post results here.

deploy-bot: Canary wave 1 (5%) finished — smoke=pass, errors=0, p50=230ms, p95=580ms, metrics: https://go/metrics/1.12.0/wave1

anita.release: Wave1 looks clean. Perf within expected bounds, no elevated errors. Proceed to wave2.

deploy-bot: Canary wave 2 (30%) finished — smoke=pass, errors=0.2% (5 reqs), p50=260ms, p95=860ms. No rollback triggered.

maya.prod: thanks all. I'll publish the internal announce at 10:30 PT to #general and tag product + sales. Anything else before I send?

kai.oncall: good to go. I'll monitor dashboards and PagerDuty.

sam.eng: pushing final RN to GH release notes now, will update the release link with the sha and pin info.
